planets.name: HAT-P-40 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Taika with a 4.46-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: HAT-P-40 b was found in 2012 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Taika. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
